en.text: Jehoash began to reign in the seventh year of Jehu, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.

zhSimplified.text: 耶户第七年，约阿施登基，在耶路撒冷作王四十年。他母亲名叫西比亚，是别是巴人。

zhTraditional.text: 耶戶第七年，約阿施登基，在耶路撒冷作王四十年。他母親名叫西比亞，是別是巴人。

en.text: Jehoash did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes all his days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

zhSimplified.text: 约阿施在祭司耶何耶大教训他的时候，就行耶和华眼中看为正的事；

zhTraditional.text: 約阿施在祭司耶何耶大教訓他的時候，就行耶和華眼中看為正的事；

en.text: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

zhSimplified.text: 只是邱坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。

zhTraditional.text: 只是邱壇還沒有廢去，百姓仍在那裏獻祭燒香。

en.text: Jehoash said to the priests, “All the money of the holy things that is brought into the LORD’s house, in current money, the money of the people for whom each man is evaluated, and all the money that it comes into any man’s heart to bring into the LORD’s house,

zhSimplified.text: 约阿施对众祭司说：「凡奉到耶和华殿分别为圣之物所值通用的银子，或各人当纳的身价，或乐意奉到耶和华殿的银子，

zhTraditional.text: 約阿施對眾祭司說：「凡奉到耶和華殿分別為聖之物所值通用的銀子，或各人當納的身價，或樂意奉到耶和華殿的銀子，

en.text: let the priests take it to them, each man from his donor; and they shall repair the damage to the house, wherever any damage is found.”

zhSimplified.text: 你们当从所认识的人收了来，修理殿的一切破坏之处。」

zhTraditional.text: 你們當從所認識的人收了來，修理殿的一切破壞之處。」

en.text: But it was so, that in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash the priests had not repaired the damage to the house.

zhSimplified.text: 无奈到了约阿施王二十三年，祭司仍未修理殿的破坏之处。

zhTraditional.text: 無奈到了約阿施王二十三年，祭司仍未修理殿的破壞之處。

en.text: Then King Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and for the other priests, and said to them, “Why aren’t you repairing the damage to the house? Now therefore take no more money from your treasurers, but deliver it for repair of the damage to the house.”

zhSimplified.text: 所以约阿施王召了大祭司耶何耶大和众祭司来，对他们说：「你们怎么不修理殿的破坏之处呢？从今以后，你们不要从所认识的人再收银子，要将所收的交出来，修理殿的破坏之处。」

zhTraditional.text: 所以約阿施王召了大祭司耶何耶大和眾祭司來，對他們說：「你們怎麼不修理殿的破壞之處呢？從今以後，你們不要從所認識的人再收銀子，要將所收的交出來，修理殿的破壞之處。」

en.text: The priests consented that they should take no more money from the people, and not repair the damage to the house.

zhSimplified.text: 众祭司答应不再收百姓的银子，也不修理殿的破坏之处。

zhTraditional.text: 眾祭司答應不再收百姓的銀子，也不修理殿的破壞之處。

en.text: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into the LORD’s house; and the priests who kept the threshold put all the money that was brought into the LORD’s house into it.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司耶何耶大取了一个柜子，在柜盖上钻了一个窟窿，放于坛旁，在进耶和华殿的右边；守门的祭司将奉到耶和华殿的一切银子投在柜里。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司耶何耶大取了一個櫃子，在櫃蓋上鑽了一個窟窿，放於壇旁，在進耶和華殿的右邊；守門的祭司將奉到耶和華殿的一切銀子投在櫃裏。

en.text: When they saw that there was much money in the chest, the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put it in bags and counted the money that was found in the LORD’s house.

zhSimplified.text: 他们见柜里的银子多了，便叫王的书记和大祭司上来，将耶和华殿里的银子数算包起来。

zhTraditional.text: 他們見櫃裏的銀子多了，便叫王的書記和大祭司上來，將耶和華殿裏的銀子數算包起來。

en.text: They gave the money that was weighed out into the hands of those who did the work, who had the oversight of the LORD’s house; and they paid it out to the carpenters and the builders who worked on the LORD’s house,

zhSimplified.text: 把所平的银子交给督工的，就是耶和华殿里办事的人；他们把银子转交修理耶和华殿的木匠和工人，

zhTraditional.text: 把所平的銀子交給督工的，就是耶和華殿裏辦事的人；他們把銀子轉交修理耶和華殿的木匠和工人，

en.text: and to the masons and the stone cutters, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the damage to the LORD’s house, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.

zhSimplified.text: 并瓦匠、石匠，又买木料和凿成的石头，修理耶和华殿的破坏之处，以及修理殿的各样使用。

zhTraditional.text: 並瓦匠、石匠，又買木料和鑿成的石頭，修理耶和華殿的破壞之處，以及修理殿的各樣使用。

en.text: But there were not made for the LORD’s house cups of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessels of gold or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the LORD’s house;

zhSimplified.text: 但那奉到耶和华殿的银子，没有用以做耶和华殿里的银杯、蜡剪、碗、号，和别样的金银器皿，

zhTraditional.text: 但那奉到耶和華殿的銀子，沒有用以做耶和華殿裏的銀杯、蠟剪、碗、號，和別樣的金銀器皿，

en.text: for they gave that to those who did the work, and repaired the LORD’s house with it.

zhSimplified.text: 乃将那银子交给督工的人修理耶和华的殿；

zhTraditional.text: 乃將那銀子交給督工的人修理耶和華的殿；

en.text: Moreover they didn’t demand an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to give to those who did the work; for they dealt faithfully.

zhSimplified.text: 且将银子交给办事的人转交做工的人，不与他们算账，因为他们办事诚实。

zhTraditional.text: 且將銀子交給辦事的人轉交做工的人，不與他們算賬，因為他們辦事誠實。

en.text: The money for the trespass offerings and the money for the sin offerings was not brought into the LORD’s house. It was the priests’.

zhSimplified.text: 惟有赎愆祭、赎罪祭的银子没有奉到耶和华的殿，都归祭司。

zhTraditional.text: 惟有贖愆祭、贖罪祭的銀子沒有奉到耶和華的殿，都歸祭司。

en.text: Then Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Gath, and took it; and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，亚兰王哈薛上来攻打迦 特，攻取了，就定意上来攻打耶路撒冷。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，亞蘭王哈薛上來攻打迦特，攻取了，就定意上來攻打耶路撒冷。

en.text: Jehoash king of Judah took all the holy things that Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own holy things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the LORD’s house, and of the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria; and he went away from Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 犹大王约阿施将他列祖犹大王约沙法、约兰、亚哈谢所分别为圣的物和自己所分别为圣的物，并耶和华殿与王宫府库里所有的金子都送给亚兰王哈薛；哈薛就不上耶路撒冷来了。

zhTraditional.text: 猶大王約阿施將他列祖猶大王約沙法、約蘭、亞哈謝所分別為聖的物和自己所分別為聖的物，並耶和華殿與王宮府庫裏所有的金子都送給亞蘭王哈薛；哈薛就不上耶路撒冷來了。

en.text: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

zhSimplified.text: 约阿施其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。

zhTraditional.text: 約阿施其餘的事，凡他所行的都寫在猶大列王記上。

en.text: His servants arose and made a conspiracy, and struck Joash at the house of Millo, on the way that goes down to Silla.

zhSimplified.text: 约阿施的臣仆起来背叛，在下悉拉的米罗宫那里将他杀了。

zhTraditional.text: 約阿施的臣僕起來背叛，在下悉拉的米羅宮那裏將他殺了。

en.text: For Jozacar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.

zhSimplified.text: 杀他的那臣仆就是示米押的儿子约撒甲和朔默的儿子约萨拔。众人将他葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子亚玛谢接续他作王。

zhTraditional.text: 殺他的那臣僕就是示米押的兒子約撒甲和朔默的兒子約薩拔。眾人將他葬在大衛城他列祖的墳地裏。他兒子亞瑪謝接續他作王。
